SELECT srd.id, srd.main_id, sr.source_id, srd.sku_id, srd.sku_no, si.warehouse_org_id AS inventoryOrgId, sd.qty AS salesQty, sd.amount AS salesAmount, sd.is_gift, sd.is_close, sd.remark, si.warehouse_id, sd.currency, sd.currency_Symbol, si.id AS soId, srd.return_type_dict, srd.return_reason_dict FROM so_return sr INNER JOIN so_return_detail srd ON srd.main_id = sr.id AND sr.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN so_info si ON sr.source_id = si.id AND srd.is_deleted = FALSE INNER JOIN so_detail sd ON srd.source_detail_id = sd.id AND si.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE sd.is_deleted = FALSE AND sd.is_close = FALSE
AND srd.id = #{id}
